content: While at MagicCon: Atlanta 2026, one of the trickier Magic: The Gathering Commander decks I faced was led by Maralen, Fae Ascendant, from Lorwyn Eclipsed. Currently the 40th most popular Commander, according to data from EDHREC, Maralen is a typal Commander, meaning that her abilities emphasize creature types. In this case, she’s all about two kinds of creatures rather than just one. Specifically, this is an elves and faeries Commander. Since her color identity has three colors — black, green, and blue — that gives every Maralen deck access to a wide variety of both creature types to leverage some big payoffs.
